summary: The team is pushing forward on two fronts: finalizing the knowledge website redesign and launching an AI-search visibility strategy for Asia Star and Intelligent China, while resolving a lingering Outlook lockout and preparing CKGSB Monthly assets.
summaryDetail: The most immediate priority is the knowledge website redesign: Joseph must share the HTML concept, the team needs a 30-minute feedback session to mark specific changes, and Joker will then implement those changes—decisions already made include removing the standalone videos section, keeping the two-menu structure, and integrating BCI/BSI indices. In parallel, the SEO/AI visibility strategy for Asia Star and Intelligent China is gaining momentum, with Joseph tasked to draft target areas/prompts and define audience profiles from CRM leads, while the team obtains the Google Analytics conversion tracking brief. Urgent this week: all team members must update saved passwords on every device and confirm the backend account unlock with JSB to resolve the Outlook lockout. Upcoming: CKGSB Monthly will use the improved header design with actual river VI files (motion graphic version to be explored with Flow), and the school PPT copy delivery to Flow has been postponed by two weeks; also, TIAN Xuefang will schedule a LinkedIn call, LIU Xuan will share a concept note with Shengjia, and Joseph will ask Flow for a stronger banner by next week.
